description: This file defines a custom Polymer element called <demo-snippet> that displays code snippets along with their rendered demos. It imports other Polymer components such as polymer.html, prism-highlighter.html, and marked-element.html, and includes template styles and JavaScript logic to process and display code within the demo.

classes.name: demo-snippet
classes.description: Custom Polymer element that displays a code snippet along with its demo and markdown rendering.

methods.name: attached
methods.description: Lifecycle callback that initializes the markdown content and stamps the template into the DOM after the element is attached.
